LESSON: SOIL

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade one
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Natural Environment
Topic 2.2: Soil
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Soil, part of Natural Environment in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade one ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How can we play with soil? 2. How could we model different objects from soil?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Soil together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: Learners develop the skill of listening/observing keenly and speaking/signing engagingly as they

recite poems and sing/sign-sing songs

● Self-efficacy- Learners develop high self-esteem as they model different objects using soil.

● Creativity and imagination: Learners develop originality skills as they model different objects using soil.

Values:
● Unity: Cooperation as learners take roles during modelling of different objects using soil.

● Social justice: Learners enhance inclusion as they taking turns to fill and empty cans with soil for fun.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
● Health Promotion Issues: Health and hygiene skills are developed by learners as they wash hands with soap and clean running water

after the modelling activity.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Creative Activities: as learners model different objects using soil.

Adapted learner’s book, digital devices, different types of soil, water, containers, bottles,
